classification.difficultyReason: Count grid lengths and identify the perpendicular distance to a chosen base, including an external height, before applying the triangle area formula.

content.prompt: Find the area of each of these triangles. Imagine that they are drawn on $1\text{ cm}^2$ grid paper.

spec.description: Unit grid and triangle; ordinary source blue outlines become black and decorative fill is omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (0,2), (2,2), with y increasing downwards; base 2 cm and perpendicular height 2 cm.

spec.description: Unit grid and triangle; ordinary outlines black, decorative fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,3), (3,0), (3,3), y increasing downwards; base and height both 3 cm.

spec.description: Unit grid and triangle; ordinary outlines black, decorative fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (0,3), (2,2), y increasing downwards; vertical base 3 cm, horizontal height 2 cm.

answer.worked:
Use the vertical side as the base; its perpendicular height is horizontal.

$$\begin{align*}A&=\tfrac12 bh\\A&=\tfrac12\times3\times2\\A&=3\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal-top triangle on a unit grid; ordinary outlines black, decorative fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (4,0), (3,3), y increasing downwards; base 4 cm and height 3 cm. Grid lines must pass through integer coordinates.

spec.description: Unit grid with apex halfway between vertical grid lines; ordinary outlines black, decorative fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,2), (0.5,0), (2,2), y increasing downwards; base 2 cm and height 2 cm.

spec.description: Unit grid and triangle whose perpendicular height meets the extension of its vertical base; ordinary outlines black, decorative fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,3), (3,0), (3,2), y increasing downwards; vertical base 2 cm and horizontal height 3 cm.

answer.worked:
Use the vertical side as the base. The horizontal perpendicular distance to its line is $3\text{ cm}$.

$$\begin{align*}A&=\tfrac12 bh\\A&=\tfrac12\times2\times3\\A&=3\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unit grid with right vertex halfway between horizontal grid lines; ordinary outlines black, decorative fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (0,3), (2,1.5), y increasing downwards; vertical base 3 cm and horizontal height 2 cm.

answer.worked:
Use the vertical side as the base; its perpendicular height is horizontal.

$$\begin{align*}A&=\tfrac12 bh\\A&=\tfrac12\times3\times2\\A&=3\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unit grid with lower vertex halfway between vertical grid lines; ordinary outlines black, decorative fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,0), (4,0), (1.5,3), y increasing downwards; base 4 cm and height 3 cm.
